name: KUT Deliverable C
description: Kampala Uganda Temple — Deliverable C (100% documentation) verification gate, A1 Phase 2 close. Deliverable B's shape at LOD 350, plus the two things that only matter once the set is issued for bidding: SpecLink reconciliation and the sheet register / sheet-compliance output. Verified at LOD 350 — coordinated interfaces are contractual at this gate, which is why the A1/A2 reconciliation states C at 350 rather than 300. CSI ORDERING: CSI_Assign runs immediately BEFORE SpecLink_Reconcile and the order is load-bearing. Reconciliation compares the model's CSI sections against the issued RIB SpecLink TOC; if nothing has assigned CSI_SECTION_TXT first, every spec section reports as a gap and every model section as over-spec, and the report is worthless. Do not reorder these two. PROGRAM AUDIT: third and final A1 program audit (Owner's shared Excel + pdf + deficiency log). FOHLIO: the A1 room-finishes round-trip is repeated here so the issued set and the Fohlio register agree; finishes match by ROOM NUMBER, not by tag. Authoring stays with the design consultants; this workflow verifies, it does not author.

steps.label: 1. Re-tag stale elements changed since Deliverable B
2. Tag validation — all 8 segments present + code-valid
3. Token-fill confidence — surfaces silent defaults before issue
4. Owner-standards rule pack (corporate baseline + KUT project overrides)
5. A1 program audit — third and final; feeds the Owner's shared Excel + pdf + deficiency log
6. Assign CSI MasterFormat sections — MUST run before step 7; reconciling without it reports every section as a gap
7. Reconcile the issued RIB SpecLink TOC against the model (runs AFTER step 6, never before)
8. Device coordination audit — A1 Deliverable C DEVICE COORDINATION clause
9. Export room finishes in Fohlio shape (matched by ROOM NUMBER, not by tag)
10. Import the Fohlio finishes register back onto the rooms
11. FF&E currency audit — missing FOHLIO_REF_TXT + stale rows
12. LOD 350 verification (pick 'deliverable-c' at the milestone prompt)
13. Rule-based clash — the issued set must be coordinated
14. Export grouped clashes to BCF 2.1 (import as ACC Issues)
15. Sheet compliance — the issued-for-bidding set is checked as a set
16. Sheet register CSV — the issue record for the bidding set
18. Composite compliance dashboard — Deliverable C sign-off
